basic_details.job_title: Central Bank of India FLCC Counselor/ Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

application_fee.details: The application is free of cost.

age_limit.details: The candidate must be less than 65 years of age, with good health, as of 31.10.2026. Retired officers must be at least 45 years of age.

qualification.details: The candidate must be less than 65 years of age, with good health, as of 31.10.2026. Retired officers must be at least 45 years of age.

salary_details.pay_scale: As per notification terms (modified pension/allowance rules apply)
salary_details.flcc counselor/director: As per notification terms (monthly compensation not exceeding Rs. 25000/- or the reduced pension amount plus specified mobile and conveyance allowances)
salary_details.details: The consolidated remuneration will be governed by the bank's rules. Travel expenses for official journeys will be reimbursed as per the bank's norms.

selection_process: Eligible candidates will be called for a personal interview
and the selection decision of the bank will be final.
how_to_apply: Download the application format from the official notification PDF.
Fill out the application form completely and accurately with all required details.
Affix a passport-size photograph and enclose necessary documents.
Place the application form inside an envelope.
Super-scribe the envelope with "Application for the post of Recruitment as Director/Counselor for FLCC on contract".
Send the completed application by speed post or registered post to Regional Manager, Central Bank of India, Regional Office, Hotel Airlines Building, Opposite MBS Hospital, Nayapura, Kota - 324001.
Ensure the application reaches the destination on or before 23.10.2026.
important_instructions: Only eligible candidates should apply after reviewing all criteria. Incomplete applications or those received after 23.10.2026 will be rejected without notice. The initial appointment is for one year on a satisfactory performance basis, renewable annually up to a maximum age of 65 years at the sole discretion of the bank. Applicants must be residents of the same state, preferably the same or nearby district. Retired officers must have clean service records without any major penalty imposed during their employment. The bank reserves the right to reject any application or cancel the process without assigning reasons. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview unless specified.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Central Bank of India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Central Bank of India, Regional Office Kota, to hire 1 FLCC Counselor/Director on a contract basis for Jhalawar and Baran.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy advertised for the FLCC Counselor/Director post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a recognized university, computer literate, and proficient in the local language, with preference given to retired bank officers or ex-servicemen with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be less than 65 years of age and at least 45 years of age as of 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, the application fee is free.

faq.question: Q7. How should I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their filled offline application form in an envelope super-scribed with the post name to the Regional Office Kota address via registered or speed post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be called for a personal interview conducted by the bank.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or remuneration?
faq.answer: The remuneration is structured as per the notification terms, not exceeding Rs. 25000/- per month along with fixed conveyance and mobile allowances, subject to pension adjustments where applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contract appointment for one year, renewable annually up to age 65 based on satisfactory performance and bank discretion.
